{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing)
valid_converted = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the required statistics
print(f"Number of converted customers: {len(converted_df)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_converted)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}")"}
